text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Something ain't right with the Majimun.
It feels even more wicked than before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにやら、
マジムンの様子がおかしいどす。
今までよりも
邪な気配が濃くなりましたなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Check it out, Princess.
There's hitodama coming out from that pot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見ろよ姫さん、
あのツボから人魂みたいなのが出てやがる……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Urgh...!
My body feels all heavy!
It's like I'm right at the bottom of the sea...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～～～
なんだか体が重いさ～！
海の深いとこまで
沈んでるみたいよ～……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Seems like those hitodama are the cause!
They're inhibiting our strength!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうやら
あの人魂が原因のようどすな……！
うちらの力が
抑えられてるみたいやわ……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Man, even Kaori's feeling it.
Looks like we're gonna need a different approach for this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
元気が取り柄のカオリでさえこれかよ……
どうやら
今までとは違う戦いになりそうだな。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
We can't go all out,
but we should still be able to manage it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
全力が出せへんでも、
やりようはいくらでもあります。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's all about guts and vigor!

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Uh, I don't think that's what she meant.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
多分姫さんはそういうこと言ったんじゃないと思うぞ……？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Anyway,
you're in for a shock if you think this is enough to take us down!
I hope you're ready for a beating!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんにせよ、
この程度であたしらを倒せると思ったら大間違いだぜ！
覚悟しやがれ！
